pages.text: Before surgery:$(br)- $(l)anesthesia$(): ketamine (minutes) or a propofol drip (while it drips); with propofol — intubate;$(br)- or $(l)local$(): lidocaine into the part;$(br)- $(l)mask$() and $(l)gloves$(), $(l)sterile$() instruments;
- place: a table beats a bed, a bed beats the ground.$(br2)Awake without analgesia every step hurts badly ($(cfg)80$()).
Worn on the face. Without it infection ×$(cfg)1.3$().
